description:
This is a Sources Sought Notice issued in accordance with FAR Part 10 for Elevator Preventive Maintenance and Repair Services at the Eastern Colorado Area Office (ECAO) and Carter Lake Shaft House (CLSH) in Loveland, Colorado.

The requirement includes preventive maintenance, repair services, emergency response, and required testing.

Interested vendors are encouraged to review the attached Sources Sought Notice for detailed technical requirements and submission instructions.

This notice is for market research purposes only and no solicitation is being issued at this time.
